name: Gaudi's cross
_about: GAUDI'S FOUR-ARMED CROSS: an upright and two bars through it at right angles, so that it points to the four quarters and up -- on the administration pavilion's tower at Park Guell (3.8m), on Casa Batllo's turret, on the Bellesguard. Stand it on whatever carries it; h is its height from there.

params._h: its height; arm: each arm's reach from the upright; t: the bars' thickness

shaft._about: the upright, the arm that points to the sky

arms._about: the four arms, to the four quarters: two bars crossing at the height of the top arm's length under the top

tips._about: a knob at every arm's end, the cross's ends thickened as Gaudi's are
